status_note_zh: 百年京张 AI 创新带城市设计开源征集已于北京时间2026年8月7日开放，8月31日截止。9月起可评估哪些输入值得进入专业深化；现实实施须另行决策、公众参与和审批。
status_note_en: The Centennial Jing-Zhang AI Innovation Belt Open Call for Urban Design opened on August 7, 2026 (Beijing time) and closes on August 31. From September, inputs may be evaluated for professional development; real-world implementation requires separate decisions, public participation, and approval.
